newsitem.title: USA: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Texas/w Okla feedlot cattle at standstill - USDA.

text.p: Trade was at a standstill in the Panhandle area on Monday, USDA said. Slaughter steers and heifers were not tested. Feedlots reporting moderate inquiry from buyers. The last established price was $63.00-$64.00 per cwt on Thursday.
Monday's packer bids were $63.00-$64.00 early, uncertain
late with lower undertone, asking prices $65.00-$66.00.
